verdict.rationale: Figma ships official SDKs/APIs for AI-native building: REST API with OpenAPI spec and TypeScript types (figma-docs-46), a Plugin API (figma-docs-8), Code Connect CLI (figma-probe-4, figma-probe-rt-1 confirming it runs keylessly), and an official MCP server both local and hosted with live OAuth-protected endpoint (figma-probe-3, figma-probe-rt-2). These are well-documented with quickstart guides and changelogs (figma-docs-47, figma-docs-48). missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials building production integrations against these SDKs, and a working OpenAPI discovery endpoint (figma-probe-2 shows all standard openapi.json paths 404 despite the spec existing on GitHub).
